content.title: Is stock market open today, Easter Monday 2026? Is stock market closed today for federal holiday?
content.text: April 6, 2026, 4:05 a.m. ETEaster Monday is not a federal holiday in the United States.The U.S. stock markets, including the NYSE and Nasdaq, will be open for trading on Easter Monday.Most banks, the U.S. Postal Service, FedEx, and UPS will operate as normal on Easter Monday.The stock markets were closed on Good Friday, but what about Easter Monday?Similarly, the religious holiday is not a federal holiday, but the U.S. stock markets should be fully operational.Here's what will be open or closed on Easter Monday from banks and USPS mail delivery to the stock market:Is Easter Monday 2026 a federal holiday today in the U.S.?Easter Monday is not specified by law to be one of the 12 federal holidays recognized in 2026, according to opm.gov.Is the stock market open on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026? Is stock market closed today?The stock markets on New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq are open for trading on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026. The Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association is also recommended to be open all day long.Will banks be closed on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026? Are banks open today?Most banks will be open on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026, according to The Federal Reserve.Is USPS post office open on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026? Will mail be delivered today?The United States Postal Service will be open, and mail will be delivered on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026.Is FedEx open today on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026?FedEx will be open on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026, and is expected to operate as normal.Is UPS open today on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026?UPS Store and UPS delivery and pickup services are open Easter Monday, April 6, 2026, and are expected to operate as normal.Is Easter Monday a state holiday in Indiana?Easter Monday is not a state holiday in Indiana. State government offices will be open.Are Indiana schools closed today on Easter Monday?Some schools may close on Easter Monday or be on spring break, while other schools may remain open in Indiana. Be sure to check with your local school for details.Chris Sims is a trending reporter at Midwest Connect Gannett. Follow him on Twitter: @ChrisFSims.
